items.prompt:
Edit the attached exact equal-size 4x4 template. Create SIXTEEN accurate FULL-COLOR sports vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Each scene is an isolated clear adult sport illustration on neutral white paper, realistic anatomically correct bodies, natural skin, identifiable body contacts, ordinary unbranded uniform. Sumo: plain dark-blue mawashi for the performer, red mawashi for the opponent, simple clay ring edge. Judo: adult white-gi performer and blue-gi opponent on plain green tatami. Use a clear side or three-quarter view that exposes the named grip, contact point and direction. A short red motion arrow may clarify direction. Preserve all five horizontal and five vertical continuous pure #ff00ff thin dividers and equal cell sizes exactly. No magenta in artwork; no captions, numbers, letters, logos or fictional characters. Use ordinary natural full colors, never monochrome or blue themed. Keep each complete scene inside its cell, no large margin required. Meaning correspondence and anatomy take precedence over dramatic poses. Sixteen subjects:
1. 切り返し: 相撲で、相手の膝の後ろに自分の膝を当て、後ろへ倒す決まり手。
2. 河津掛け: 相撲で、相手の脚に自分の脚を絡め、体を反らせて倒す決まり手。
3. 蹴返し: 相撲で、相手の脚を内側から足で払い、手の動きも使って倒す決まり手。
4. 蹴手繰り: 相撲で、立ち合いに相手の脚を内側から払い、引き倒す決まり手。
5. 三所攻め: 相撲で、相手の脚を掛けてもう一方の脚を持ち、頭でも押して倒す決まり手。
6. 渡し込み: 相撲で、相手のももの後ろを抱えながら押し倒す決まり手。
7. 二枚蹴り: 相撲で、相手を浮かせ、脚の外側を足で払って倒す決まり手。
8. 小股掬い: 相撲で、相手が前へ出した脚の内側を手ですくって倒す決まり手。
9. 外小股: 相撲で、相手の脚を外側から手ですくって倒す決まり手。
10. 大股: 相撲で、相手の脚をすくい、踏み替えたもう一方の脚もすくって倒す決まり手。
11. 褄取り: 相撲で、相手の足先をつかんで引き上げ、倒す決まり手。
12. 小褄取り: 相撲で、相手の足先を内側から取って引き上げ、倒す決まり手。
13. 裾取り: 相撲で、相手の足首をつかんで倒す決まり手。
14. 裾払い: 相撲で、相手の足首付近を足で払って倒す決まり手。
15. 居反り: 相撲で、相手の下にもぐり、体を反らせて後ろへ倒す決まり手。
16. 撞木反り: 相撲で、相手を肩に担ぐ形から体を反らせて倒す決まり手。

4. 伝え反り: 相撲で、相手の腕の下をくぐり、反りながら体を伝わせて倒す決まり手。
5. 巻き落とし: 相撲で、相手の体を抱えるように巻き込み、横へ倒す決まり手。
6. とったり: 相撲で、相手の腕を両手で抱え、体をひねって倒す決まり手。
7. 逆とったり: 相撲で、とったりを仕掛けた相手に、腕を抜くようにして仕掛け返す決まり手。
8. 肩透かし: 相撲で、相手の腕の内側から肩を抱え、体をかわして引き倒す決まり手。
9. 外無双: 相撲で、相手の脚の外側に手を当て、体をひねって倒す決まり手。
10. 内無双: 相撲で、相手の脚の内側に手を当て、体をひねって倒す決まり手。
11. 頭捻り: 相撲で、相手の胸や肩に当てた頭を支点にして体をひねり、倒す決まり手。
12. 上手捻り: 相撲で、腕の外側から持ったまわしを使い、相手の体をひねって倒す決まり手。

14. 網打ち: 相撲で、相手の腕を抱え、網を打つように体をひねって倒す決まり手。

items.prompt:
Edit the attached exact equal-size 4x4 template. Create SIXTEEN accurate FULL-COLOR sports vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Each scene is an isolated clear adult sport illustration on neutral white paper, realistic anatomically correct bodies, natural skin, identifiable body contacts, ordinary unbranded uniform. Sumo: plain dark-blue mawashi for the performer, red mawashi for the opponent, simple clay ring edge. Judo: adult white-gi performer and blue-gi opponent on plain green tatami. Use a clear side or three-quarter view that exposes the named grip, contact point and direction. A short red motion arrow may clarify direction. Preserve all five horizontal and five vertical continuous pure #ff00ff thin dividers and equal cell sizes exactly. No magenta in artwork; no captions, numbers, letters, logos or fictional characters. Use ordinary natural full colors, never monochrome or blue themed. Keep each complete scene inside its cell, no large margin required. Meaning correspondence and anatomy take precedence over dramatic poses. Sixteen subjects:
1. 内股: 柔道で、相手の内ももを脚で払い上げて投げる技。
2. 巴投: 柔道で、後ろに倒れながら相手の腹に足を当て、頭の向こうへ投げる技。
3. 隅返: 柔道で、後ろに倒れながら相手の脚の内側を足で持ち上げて投げる技。
4. 袈裟固: 柔道で、相手の横から頭と片腕を抱え、体を押さえる技。
5. 肩固: 柔道で、相手の頭と片腕をまとめて抱え、体を押さえる技。
6. 横四方固: 柔道で、相手の横から上半身と下半身を支えて押さえる技。
7. 上四方固: 柔道で、相手の頭の側から体を押さえる技。
8. 縦四方固: 柔道で、相手の体に縦向きにまたがる形で押さえる技。
9. 背負落: 柔道で、相手を背負った姿勢から膝をつき、引き落とす投技。
10. 掬投: 柔道で、相手の脚や腰を両手ですくい上げて投げる技。
11. 帯落: 柔道で、帯を持ち、相手の腰を抱えて落とす投技。
12. 浮落: 柔道で、手の引きによって相手を前へ崩して落とす投技。
13. 隅落: 柔道で、相手を斜め後ろへ崩して落とす投技。
14. 山嵐: 柔道で、相手の襟と袖を持ち、脚を払い上げて投げる技。
15. 帯取返: 柔道で、肩越しに相手の帯を持ち、体を返すように投げる技。
16. 双手刈: 柔道で、相手の両脚を両手で抱えて刈る投技。

items.prompt:
Edit the attached exact equal-size 4x4 template. Create SIXTEEN accurate FULL-COLOR sports vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Each scene is an isolated clear adult sport illustration on neutral white paper, realistic anatomically correct bodies, natural skin, identifiable body contacts, ordinary unbranded uniform. Sumo: plain dark-blue mawashi for the performer, red mawashi for the opponent, simple clay ring edge. Judo: adult white-gi performer and blue-gi opponent on plain green tatami. Use a clear side or three-quarter view that exposes the named grip, contact point and direction. A short red motion arrow may clarify direction. Preserve all five horizontal and five vertical continuous pure #ff00ff thin dividers and equal cell sizes exactly. No magenta in artwork; no captions, numbers, letters, logos or fictional characters. Use ordinary natural full colors, never monochrome or blue themed. Keep each complete scene inside its cell, no large margin required. Meaning correspondence and anatomy take precedence over dramatic poses. Sixteen subjects:
1. 朽木倒: 柔道で、相手の片脚を持ち上げ、体を後ろへ崩す投技。
2. 踵返: 柔道で、相手のかかと付近を手で取って崩す投技。
3. 内股すかし: 柔道で、相手の内股をかわして投げ返す技。
4. 小内返: 柔道で、相手の小内刈をかわして投げ返す技。
5. 腰車: 柔道で、腰を軸にして相手を回転させて投げる技。
6. 袖釣込腰: 柔道で、相手の袖を引き上げ、腰に乗せて投げる技。
7. 釣腰: 柔道で、相手の後ろ帯を持って引き寄せ、腰で投げる技。
8. 跳腰: 柔道で、腰と脚を使って相手を跳ね上げる投技。
9. 移腰: 柔道で、相手を持ち上げ、自分の腰に移して投げ返す技。
10. 後腰: 柔道で、技を仕掛けた相手を後ろから抱え上げて落とす投技。
11. 小外掛: 柔道で、相手の脚の外側へ脚を掛けて投げる技。
12. 足車: 柔道で、相手の膝付近に当てた脚を軸にして投げる技。
13. 払釣込足: 柔道で、相手を引き上げながら足首付近を払い、投げる技。
14. 大車: 柔道で、相手のももの上部に当てた脚を軸にして投げる技。
15. 大外車: 柔道で、相手の両脚の後ろに脚を当てて投げる技。
16. 大外落: 柔道で、相手の脚の後ろに自分の脚を下ろして崩す投技。

items.prompt:
CRITICAL: use sixteen EXACTLY EQUAL SQUARE PANELS. All FOUR ROW HEIGHTS MUST BE IDENTICAL. Internal horizontal separators at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% of the canvas; never move a divider to fit a pose. Paint within the template cells. No pink or lavender tint in paper. White judogi uses NEUTRAL GRAY shading, never pink/magenta highlights. Preserve natural full colors.
Edit the attached exact equal-size 4x4 template. Create SIXTEEN accurate FULL-COLOR sports vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Each scene is an isolated clear adult sport illustration on neutral white paper, realistic anatomically correct bodies, natural skin, identifiable body contacts, ordinary unbranded uniform. Sumo: plain dark-blue mawashi for the performer, red mawashi for the opponent, simple clay ring edge. Judo: adult white-gi performer and blue-gi opponent on plain green tatami. Use a clear side or three-quarter view that exposes the named grip, contact point and direction. A short red motion arrow may clarify direction. Preserve all five horizontal and five vertical continuous pure #ff00ff thin dividers and equal cell sizes exactly. No magenta in artwork; no captions, numbers, letters, logos or fictional characters. Use ordinary natural full colors, never monochrome or blue themed. Keep each complete scene inside its cell, no large margin required. Meaning correspondence and anatomy take precedence over dramatic poses. Sixteen subjects:
1. 燕返: 柔道で、相手の出足払をかわし、足を払って投げ返す技。
2. 大外返: 柔道で、相手の大外刈を大外刈で返す技。
3. 大内返: 柔道で、相手の大内刈に応じて脚を払い、投げ返す技。
4. 跳腰返: 柔道で、相手の跳腰に応じて支え脚を払い、投げ返す技。
5. 払腰返: 柔道で、相手の払腰に応じて支え脚を払い、投げ返す技。
6. 内股返: 柔道で、相手の内股に応じて支え脚を払い、投げ返す技。
7. 裏投: 柔道で、相手を抱え上げ、自分も後ろへ倒れながら投げる技。
8. 引込返: 柔道で、相手の帯を持って引き込み、体を倒して投げる技。
9. 俵返: 柔道で、前かがみの相手を抱え、自分も後ろへ倒れて投げる技。
10. 横落: 柔道で、自分の体を横へ倒しながら相手を横に落とす投技。
11. 谷落: 柔道で、相手の脚の後ろに脚を伸ばし、体を倒して投げる技。
12. 跳巻込: 柔道で、跳腰の動きから相手を体に巻き込み、倒れて投げる技。
13. 外巻込: 柔道で、相手の腕を外側から抱えて自分の体に巻き込み、投げる技。
14. 内巻込: 柔道で、相手の腕の内側へ入り、体に巻き込んで投げる技。
15. 浮技: 柔道で、相手を斜め前へ崩し、自分の体を横へ倒して投げる技。
16. 横分: 柔道で、相手の足元に体を横たえ、横へ投げる技。

items.prompt:
Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. EXACT sixteen scenes:
1. 交通カード: 電車やバスなどの運賃の支払いなどに使うカード。
2. カードケース: カードをまとめて保管したり持ち歩いたりする容器。
3. キーケース: 鍵をまとめて入れ、持ち歩くための容器。
4. フォトフレーム: 写真を入れて飾るための枠。
5. 写真立て: 写真を入れて立て、飾るための枠や台。
6. 写真アルバム: 写真をまとめて保存する帳面など。
7. 壁掛けカレンダー: 壁に掛けて使う日付表。
8. 卓上カレンダー: 机の上などに置いて使う日付表。
9. 日めくりカレンダー: 一日ごとに一枚ずつめくって使う日付表。
10. 温度湿度計: 温度と、空気の湿り具合をはかる道具。
11. 湿度計: 空気の湿り具合をはかる道具。
12. 暖房器具: 室内などを暖めるための道具や機械。
13. 冷房器具: 室内などを涼しくするための道具や機械。
14. 空気清浄機: 空気中のほこりなどを取り除く機械。
15. 加湿器: 水分を出して、空気の湿り気を増やす機械。
16. 除湿機: 空気中の水分を減らす機械。

items.ageReason: 身近な物の用途を表す複合語として意味別レベル2。
items.imageReason: 今回は画像未制作。説明のみとし、外部画像を検索しない。
items.prompt:
Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. EXACT sixteen scenes:
1. 脱臭剤: 嫌なにおいを取り除いたり弱めたりするための物。
2. 芳香剤: よい香りを広げるために使う物。
3. 防虫剤: 衣類などに虫が付くのを防ぐための物。
4. ごみ袋: ごみを集めたり運んだりするための袋。
5. 分別ボックス: 種類ごとに物やごみを分けて入れる容器。
6. 資源ごみ: 再び材料などとして利用するため、分けて集めるごみ。
7. 段ボール箱: 波形の紙を挟んだ丈夫な板紙で作った箱。
8. 包装紙: 品物を包むために使う紙。
9. クッション材: 品物にかかる衝撃を和らげるための材料。
10. 梱包材: 品物を包んだり保護したりして運ぶための材料。
11. ガムテープ: 荷物の封などに使う、幅の広い粘着テープの通称。
12. メンディングテープ: 紙の補修や貼り合わせなどに使う、貼ると目立ちにくいテープ。
13. 横車: 柔道で、相手を抱え、自分の体を横へ倒して回すように投げる技。
14. 横掛: 柔道で、相手の足を横に払いながら、自分も倒れて投げる技。
15. 抱分: 柔道で、四つんばいの相手を後ろから抱え、体を倒して投げる技。
16. 大外巻込: 柔道で、大外刈の動きから相手を体に巻き込んで投げる技。

2. 流し受け: 空手で、相手の攻撃の向きをそらすように受ける技。
3. 掬い受け: 空手で、手や腕を下からすくい上げるようにして受ける技。
4. 掌底受け: 空手で、手のひらの付け根を使って攻撃を受ける技。

8. 瓢箪から駒: 思いがけないところから、意外なことが起こるたとえ。
9. 風林火山: 状況に合わせて速く動き、静かに構え、勢いよく攻め、動じないという戦い方を表す言葉。
10. 粉骨砕身: 力を惜しまず、懸命に努力すること。骨や身を砕くほど、というたとえ。
11. 亡羊の嘆: 道や学びの分野が多すぎて、目指すものを見失う嘆き。羊を見失った話に由来する。
12. 未曾有: それまで一度も起こったことがないこと。もとは仏教で珍しい出来事を表した言葉。
13. 明鏡止水: よこしまな考えやわだかまりがなく、澄み切った静かな心。
14. 竜頭蛇尾: 初めは勢いがよいのに、終わりが振るわないこと。頭が竜で尾が蛇というたとえ。
15. 老馬の智: 経験を積んだ人の知恵が役立つこと。道に迷った軍が年老いた馬に道を任せた話に由来する。
16. 馬耳東風: 意見や注意を聞いても、まったく気にしないこと。春風を気にしない馬の耳にたとえた言葉。

Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. 1. 登竜門: 成功への大切な関門。急流を登った鯉が竜になるという話に由来する。
2. 逆鱗: 目上の人などの激しい怒りのたとえ。竜の逆向きの鱗に触れると怒るという話に由来する。
3. 破竹の勢い: 止めるのが難しいほど、勢いよく進むこと。竹が続けて割れる様子にたとえた言葉。
4. 刻舟求剣: 状況が変わったのに、古い方法にこだわること。船に印を付けて落とした剣を探す話に由来する。
5. 管鮑の交わり: お互いを深く理解し、信頼する友情。管仲と鮑叔という人物の話に由来する。
6. 刎頸の交わり: 命を懸けても相手を裏切らないほどの、深い友情。

8. 傍若無人: 周りの人を気にせず、勝手に振る舞うこと。

10. 烏合の衆: 人数はいても、まとまりや規律がない集団。烏の集まりにたとえた言葉。

Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.

No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.

items.prompt:
Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. EXACT sixteen scenes:
1. かくばる: 架空のゲームの技の概念表現。ノーマルタイプの変化技。自分の攻撃の能力を上げる。 Show the named phenomenon in natural FULL COLOR. All attack targets are plain brown wooden training dummies. Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.
2. きりさく: 架空のゲームの技の概念表現。ノーマルタイプの物理技。相手の急所に当たりやすい攻撃技。 Show the named phenomenon in natural FULL COLOR. All attack targets are plain brown wooden training dummies. Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.

Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.

items.prompt:

Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. items.prompt:
Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. items.prompt:

Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. items.prompt:
Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. 1. しぜんのめぐみ: 架空のゲームの技の概念表現。ノーマルタイプの物理技。持っている木の実に応じて、タイプや威力が変わる攻撃技。 Show the named phenomenon in natural FULL COLOR. All attack targets are plain brown wooden training dummies. Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.

items.prompt:
Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. Any human needed to express an emotion or action is an original ordinary person in a plain GREEN T-SHIRT and dark shorts, with normal natural skin and hair. No martial-arts costume, headband, wrist wraps, ripped white clothing or recognizable character design. No franchise creature.

items.prompt:

Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. 1. 出る杭は打たれる: 目立つ人や優れた人が、周りから批判されやすいというたとえ。
2. 灯台下暗し: 身近なことは、かえって気付きにくいというたとえ。昔の照明の台の下が暗いことからきた言葉。
3. 時は金なり: 時間には、お金のように大切な価値があるという教え。
4. 隣の芝生は青い: 他人のものは、自分のものよりよく見えやすいというたとえ。
5. 捕らぬ狸の皮算用: まだ手に入っていない利益を、すでに得たつもりで当てにすること。

7. 無い袖は振れぬ: 持っていないお金などは、出そうとしても出せないというたとえ。
8. 泣き面に蜂: 困っているところに、さらに困り事が起こるたとえ。
9. 情けは人の為ならず: 人に親切にすると、巡り巡って自分にもよいことが返るという教え。

15. 猫に鰹節: 好きで我慢しにくいものを近くに置き、油断できない状況のたとえ。

3. 能ある鷹は爪を隠す: 本当に力のある人は、それをむやみに見せびらかさないというたとえ。

Edit the attached equal-square 4x4 template. Draw sixteen clear FULL-COLOR picture-book spot illustrations, one per white cell in row-major order. Use NATURAL COLORS that help children understand the subject: orange/red fire, blue water, green leaves, natural skin, brown wood, varied colors for ordinary objects. Never make a monochrome or blue-themed sheet. Keep the FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical pure MAGENTA #ff00ff divider lines, including outer frame, straight, continuous and at the EXACT original template positions. All cells remain equal squares. Fluorescent fuchsia/magenta belongs only to the dividers. Purple effects may use deep violet and pink objects warm rose/coral; all other subjects keep their normal natural full colors. Paint each complete subject and scene inside its cell; distinct from the divider. Pure white paper background, no tinted paper wash touching the grid. Use the cells generously, no large margins. No captions, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No copyrighted characters, recognizable franchise silhouettes or signature character costumes. A fictional game move is shown through ordinary natural phenomena/objects; if an attack needs a target, use a plain wooden training dummy. No franchise creature or imaginary creature attacker; no eyes or faces in smoke, energy or liquid. Sports use adult athletes, natural skin tones and plain uniforms, judo in white/blue judogi on tatami, sumo in plain mawashi on a dohyo. Proverbs show their meaning in a coherent scene. EXACT sixteen scenes:
1. 三つ子の魂百まで: 幼いころに身に付いた性質は、大人になっても残りやすいということわざ。
2. 無理が通れば道理が引っ込む: 筋の通らないことが認められると、正しいことが行われなくなるというたとえ。
3. 目から鱗が落ちる: 何かをきっかけに、今まで分からなかったことが急にはっきり分かること。
4. 餅は餅屋: 物事は、その道の専門家に任せるのがよいということわざ。
5. 桃栗三年柿八年: 木が実を結ぶまでに年数がかかるように、物事の成果にも時間が必要だというたとえ。
6. 藪から棒: 前触れがなく、突然であることのたとえ。
7. 藪をつついて蛇を出す: 余計なことをして、かえって災いを招くことのたとえ。
8. 油断大敵: 気を緩めることが、大きな失敗の原因になるという戒め。
9. 寄らば大樹の陰: 頼るなら、力のあるものに頼るとよいというたとえ。
10. 来年の事を言えば鬼が笑う: 先のことはどうなるか分からないというたとえ。
11. 良薬は口に苦し: 自分のためになる注意は、聞きづらいこともあるというたとえ。
12. 類は友を呼ぶ: 似た性質や考えの人は、自然と集まりやすいということわざ。
13. 渡りに船: 困っているとき、ちょうど都合のよい助けが現れることのたとえ。
14. 藁にも縋る: とても困り、頼りになりそうにないものにまで助けを求めること。
15. 大逆手: 相撲で、相手のまわしを取った腕を返すようにしてひねり倒す決まり手。
16. 腕捻り: 相撲で、相手の腕を両手で持ち、ひねって倒す決まり手。
